result.summary: Found 1 visual issue: a loading indicator is visibly overlaid on restaurant imagery.

issues.description: A circular loading spinner is centered over the Tokumaru Ramen Bar card image, obscuring the food photo and making the card appear stuck in a loading state despite the restaurant details already being visible.
issues.suggestion: Remove the spinner once the card image/content has loaded, or use a complete skeleton/loading state until the card is ready.
